annotations.text:
cucusenok.github.io redesign — dark developer portfolio.
Type: Space Grotesk (display) + IBM Plex Sans (body) + JetBrains Mono (labels). One accent color, switchable via the Theme tweak above each artboard.
Sections: Experience (from resume.json), Projects (11 existing, 5 shown), Stack with years, Writing (Medium — titles are placeholders).
Hero: option A (in Home) keeps the photo and a profile card; option B is typographic — huge name, facts in a key/value column, photo only as a 28px avatar in the nav.
